body: "

This map turns water levels into a street-level picture of potential flooding. You can explore the next several days, replay measured events, click the map for modeled depth, inspect parcels, and export what you see.

Every mapped depth is referenced to the selected water level and the ground-elevation model.

" target: ".data-source-card", body: "

Select Forecast to explore the forecast water levels and mapped flooding.

The map and timeline update together, so the selected hour is always the water level being mapped.

" body: "

Select Past to explore the tide-gauge archive. Use Interval in the left pane to switch among Hourly, 15-Min, and Daily Max views.

" body: "

The calendar is your archive. Colored dates mark flood thresholds; choose a day or type a date to replay it. Crest-only records show the maximum extent when a full time series was not preserved.

" body: "

Drag the slider to move the map through time, or press Play to animate it. The selected date, time, water level, and mapped depth always stay synchronized.

" body: "

Turn on Buildings for floor flood history and projections, or Parcels for flooded area and depth.

" body: "

The Top 10 list is the fastest way to inspect the archive's highest crests. Select an event to move the calendar, timeline, water-level readout, and inundation map to that flood.

" body: "

Open the export panel to save a single PNG, a PNG sequence, or an animated GIF. Set the time range, frame interval, layout, speed, and labels before export.

Exports preserve the map, timestamp, datum, depth key, and branding so the result can stand on its own.
